description: Marchetti runs the front of Solenne the way a good surgeon runs a theatre — nothing wasted, nothing seen that shouldn't be. Charcoal three-piece, a lapel pin shaped like the tower, and a memory for faces that has kept more people out of this lobby than any lock. He is unfailingly warm and absolutely immovable.
